import json,collections
from pathlib import Path
v=json.loads(Path("docs/natural-assistant/v4/manifest.json").read_text());rows=v["rows"];out=[]
for s in ("train","validation","test"):
 for g,pred in (("DOCCI",lambda r:r.get("image","") and r["image"].startswith("vision/images/")),("Commons",lambda r:r.get("image","") and r["image"].startswith("ocr/commons/")),("NVIDIA",lambda r:r.get("image","") and r["image"].startswith("ocr/nvidia/")),("OASST",lambda r:r.get("source")=="oasst2-curated-zh-v4"),("authored",lambda r:r.get("source")=="project-authored-traditional-chinese-v4")):
  rr=[r for r in rows if r["split"]==s and pred(r)];images={r["image"] for r in rr if r.get("image")};out.append({"group":g,"split":s,"rows":len(rr),"images":len(images),"families":len({r["family"] for r in rr}),"commons_source":sum("crop" not in x for x in images) if g=="Commons" else None,"commons_crop":sum("crop" in x for x in images) if g=="Commons" else None})
print(json.dumps({"groups":out,"audio_files":len({r["audio"] for r in v["audio_rows"]}),"audio_rows":len(v["audio_rows"]),"filepaths":{p:sum(f["path"].startswith(p) for f in v["files"]) for p in ("ocr/commons/","ocr/nvidia/","vision/images/")}},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
